title: Anomaly Detected Notification
description: Sent by the analytics service to api-core after it stored new anomalies. api-core re-reads every id from the database and publishes only what the database holds; the other members are informational and are never trusted.

anomalies.description: The anomalies that were just inserted.

id.description: The identifier of the stored anomaly row.

tenantId.description: The tenant the sender believes owns the anomaly. An id that belongs to another tenant is counted as unknown.

metricId.description: The metric the anomaly was found in.

windowStart.description: Inclusive start of the scored window, RFC 3339.

windowEnd.description: End of the scored window, RFC 3339; not before windowStart.

detector.description: The detector that produced the finding.

createdAt.description: When the anomaly row was inserted, RFC 3339.
